reason: This looks okay in general, but the details are all wrong.

collision-avoidance.detail: The cars overlap when they collide and make no attempt to avoid it, they just pass right through each other and continue on.

signal-compliance.detail: The cars seem to completely ignore the signals and never stop

lane-discipline.detail: The cars seem to be slightly obeying "English traffic rules" (lef-hand lane) ... but this is confusing to someone in the  US like me.

physical-scale.detail: The road is about 5-6 times too big for the cars

trip-integrity.detail: I cannot easily compare where the cars intend to go

visual_review.notes: The visuals are okay, but not great... and the proportions are way off.
